lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Musical Instruments. Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig have been tidying the house.
lines.zh: 乐器。猪妈妈和猪爸爸在收拾屋子。

lines.en: Mummy Pig and I found this old box in the attic. Can anyone guess what's inside? Hmm? Nope. It's full of musical instruments.
lines.zh: 我和猪妈妈在阁楼上发现了这个旧箱子。有人能猜到里面是什么吗？嗯？猜不到。里面装满了乐器。

lines.en: Wow! They are a bit old and dusty.
lines.zh: 哇！它们有点旧，还满是灰尘。

lines.en: This is the violin I used to play when I was little. Mummy, can you play your violin? I haven't played it for a long time.
lines.zh: 这是我小时候拉的小提琴。妈妈，你能拉小提琴吗？我已经很久没拉了。

lines.en: Please, Mummy, please play it. I hope I haven't forgotten how.
lines.zh: 求你了，妈妈，拉一曲吧。希望我还没忘记怎么拉。

lines.en: Bravo! Yay!
lines.zh: 太棒了！好耶！

lines.en: Mummy, can I play the violin? Hold it like this. Yes, Mummy.
lines.zh: 妈妈，我可以拉小提琴吗？要像这样拿。好的，妈妈。

lines.en: Oh, dear. I do not think it is meant to sound like that.
lines.zh: 哦，天哪。我觉得它不该是这样响的。

lines.en: George wants to try. Hold it like this.
lines.zh: 乔治也想试试。要像这样拿。

lines.en: George. Oh, that does not sound quite right, either. The violin is too hard to play.
lines.zh: 乔治。哦，这个听起来也不太对。小提琴太难拉了。

lines.en: Peppa, maybe you would do better with this tin drum. Thank you, Daddy.
lines.zh: 佩奇，也许你用这个铁皮鼓会好一些。谢谢你，爸爸。

lines.en: That sounds better. Peppa loves playing the drum. Oh, lovely. Yes, it sounds very nice.
lines.zh: 这个听起来好多了。佩奇喜欢打鼓。哦，真好听。是的，听起来非常棒。

lines.en: This is Daddy Pig's old accordion. I used to play this to Mummy Pig when we first met.
lines.zh: 这是猪爸爸的旧手风琴。我和猪妈妈刚认识的时候，常常拉给她听。

lines.en: Oh, Daddy Pig, I remember this tune.
lines.zh: 哦，猪爸爸，我记得这首曲子。

lines.en: George wants to play the accordion, too. Are you sure, George? The accordion is quite difficult.
lines.zh: 乔治也想拉手风琴。乔治，你确定吗？手风琴挺难的。

lines.en: George. The accordion is almost as difficult to play as my drum. Okay.
lines.zh: 乔治。手风琴几乎和我的鼓一样难。好吧。

lines.en: George. Oh, maybe George is a bit too little to play the accordion. Daddy, what other instruments are in the box?
lines.zh: 乔治。哦，也许乔治太小了，还拉不了手风琴。爸爸，箱子里还有什么乐器？

lines.en: Just this horn. Can I try? You have to blow it very hard.
lines.zh: 就剩这个号角了。我能试试吗？你得非常用力地吹。

lines.en: That does not sound right. It's impossible. I think I used to be able to play it.
lines.zh: 这个听起来不对。这根本不可能。我记得我以前会吹的。

lines.en: That really does not sound right. Maybe it just needs someone big and strong like me.
lines.zh: 这个听起来真的不对。也许需要像我这样又大又壮的人来吹。

lines.en: That does not sound right, either. Peppa was right. It is impossible to play.
lines.zh: 这个听起来也不对。佩奇说得对。这根本吹不响。

lines.en: Never mind, Daddy Pig, just stick to the accordion. You play it beautifully.
lines.zh: 没关系，猪爸爸，你还是拉手风琴吧。你拉得非常动听。

lines.en: Well, I do play it quite nicely, even if I say so myself. And I'll play my violin. And I will play my drum.
lines.zh: 嗯，我拉得确实挺不错的，虽然是我自己说的。那我拉小提琴。我打我的鼓。

lines.en: Mummy Pig plays the violin. Daddy Pig plays the accordion. Peppa plays the drum.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈拉小提琴，猪爸爸拉手风琴，佩奇打鼓。

lines.en: But what instrument will George play?
lines.zh: 那乔治要演奏什么乐器呢？

lines.en: George is blowing the horn. Mummy couldn't play the horn, and Daddy couldn't play it, and even I couldn't play it. But George can play it.
lines.zh: 乔治在吹号角。妈妈吹不响，爸爸也吹不响，连我都吹不响。可是乔治会吹。
